stem.text: What would be produced when $60\,\text{g}$ of nitrogen monoxide react with an excess of carbon monoxide in a catalytic converter?

A.text: $12\,\text{g}$ of carbon and $92\,\text{g}$ of nitrogen dioxide

B.text: $24\,\text{g}$ of carbon and $92\,\text{g}$ of nitrogen dioxide

C.text: $88\,\text{g}$ of carbon dioxide and $28\,\text{g}$ of nitrogen

D.text: $88\,\text{g}$ of carbon dioxide and $56\,\text{g}$ of nitrogen
